主要内容: On February 16, 2012, the board of directors of Medallion Financial Corp. approved the Compensation Committee's recommendations to award fiscal year 2011 bonuses to its executive officers. Alvin Murstein, Chief Executive Officer, received a $450,000 cash bonus; Andrew Murstein, President, received a $1,121,250 cash bonus; Larry D. Hall, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, received a $92,000 cash bonus; Brian S. OLeary, Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, received a $80,500 cash bonus; and Michael Kowalsky, Executive Vice President, received a $144,900 cash bonus. The board also approved increases in base salaries for these executives. Additionally, the board approved the grant of restricted common stock under the 2009 Employee Restricted Stock Plan, with shares vesting in equal one-third increments over three years. The shares granted to Alvin Murstein and Andrew Murstein were 27,076 each, while Larry Hall, Brian OLeary, and Michael Kowalsky received 3,610, 3,159, and 2,256 shares respectively. The approval was made on February 16, 2012, and the report was filed with the SEC on February 23, 2012.
